title: The symmetric scalar Fisher expansion has no fifth-order term and an explicit sixth-order coefficient

expansion.seed_class: X is bounded, symmetric, centered and unit variance.
expansion.hermite_integrals: int H_5^2 phi=120 and int H_4 H_3^2 phi=216.
expansion.scope_guard: The expansion is local at the Gaussian endpoint for one fixed bounded symmetric seed; it is not a uniform optimization over all seeds or finite t.
